name: Marinated Steak with Crunchy Apple, Walnut & Blue Cheese Salad

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lemons
1 ½ heads romaine lettuce
3 Granny Smith apples

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic; transfer to a medium bowl.
Juice lemons into the bowl with the garlic; add soy sauce, vinegar, Worcestershire, Dijon, and pepper. Whisk to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp soy sauce
3 tbsp white wine vinegar
1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place the steak in the marinade, turn to coat, and set aside.
Peel and mince additional garlic; transfer to a large bowl along with yogurt, blue cheese, water, vinegar, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
⅓ cup plain Greek yogurt
1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled blue cheese
2 tbsp water
1 tbsp white wine vinegar
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Chop or tear romaine into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Roughly chop walnuts and add to the bowl.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add steak to the skillet and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and let rest for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, quarter, core, and cut apples into matchsticks, add to the bowl with the romaine, and toss to combine the salad.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide salad and steak between plates. Enjoy!
